info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Account Management By Param1-spec
info.description: The Account Management Update API enables users to modify existing accounts within the Accounts Receivable system based on specific parameters. Utilizing this API, businesses can efficiently manage account information, such as updating contact details or financial records. This functionality is particularly useful for finance departments and account managers who need to maintain accurate and up-to-date information. Seamlessly integrate with your financial systems to ensure comprehensive account oversight and operational effectiveness.

patch.description: This operation allows you to update the details of a specific accounts receivable record identified by the provided account number. Ensure that the request body contains the relevant fields you wish to modify.

requestBody.description: Updates the details of the specified accounts receivable entry identified by ACC-200045. Provide the necessary fields in the request body to modify the existing record.

200.description: The request was successful and the resource has been updated.
